verdict.rationale: Bedrock AgentCore documents that agents hosted on it can call MCP servers, with AgentCore handling authentication and access control for those connections. That is a first-party, AWS-native path for an agent to use MCP tools, but the evidence is a single marketing-level mention. The awslabs MCP servers are server-side and do not count toward this client story. Missing for 10: documented steps to register or configure external MCP servers in AgentCore or Bedrock agents, tool discovery and invocation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
